title: Coventry shop ordered to close for persistently selling illegal products
summary: We've closed down a shop in Coventry following reports of criminal activity.

title: Jobs, wellbeing support and community action events coming to Bell Green
summary: Residents in Bell Green are invited to free activities for Wednesday 16 September to Friday 18 September.

title: Mayor announces £5.5m to bring homeless in from the cold this Christmas
summary: Richard Parker, Mayor of the West Midlands, has made a commitment to see every person sleeping rough in the region offered a roof over their head this Christmas, and support to stay there.

title: Major improvements planned for Longford Nature Park to boost wildlife and public accessibility
summary: Longford Nature Park is set to benefit from a series of improvements designed to enhance wildlife habitats and make the site more accessible for visitors.

title: Coventry’s rich story told in a fresh new visitor guide
summary: Coventry has a brand new visitor guide to showcase the city’s rich heritage, diverse culture and outstanding visitor attractions.

title: The Hill Group successfully moves and stores historic grade II listed mural at City Centre South
summary: The Hill Group has successfully lifted and securely stored the Grade II listed Three Tuns Mural, one of Coventry’s most distinctive pieces of post-war public art.
